entities.name: Nitro heteroaryl precursor
observations: Contains an aryl nitro group that is transformed to an aniline while the fused heterocyclic scaffold remains unchanged.

entities.name: Aryl aniline product
observations: Product is the corresponding aryl amine from nitro-group reduction.

entities.name: Aromatic nitro reduction
observations: Net transformation is conversion of an aryl nitro group to an aniline; nitro oxygens are removed and implicit hydrogens are added.
No phosphorus-mediated transformation, carboxylate loss, or ring oxygen-to-aromatic rearrangement is supported by the decoded structures.

entities.name: Fe/HCl in ethanol
observations: Matched empirical conditions use iron and hydrochloric acid in ethanol for reduction of the aromatic nitro group to an aniline.
